decisions.reason: A consumer superfood drink mix is far from the firm's industrial waste-to-energy core, so with limited slack and no evidence that it meets aspirations, problemistic search would likely redirect its resources to the technology ventures.
The modular plant extensions complement the core waste-to-energy offer and cost little to keep, although they were only ever mentioned on the website and never given their own page.
The waste oil plant had its own page and a dedicated launch announcement, which fits the firm's decentralized technology strategy, so with no clear shortfall it is likely kept.
The plastic-to-fuel plant moved up from a mention to its own page and addresses a large, growing market at the heart of the firm's strategy, making it the flagship the firm is most likely to keep.
